hero.title: Book the people who make your week better.
hero.lead: Barbers, stylists, trainers, tutors, photographers and more — with real openings, upfront prices and reviews only from verified visits.

search.label: What do you want to book?

rails.availableSoonSub: Live openings from each professional's calendar.
rails.topRatedSub: Ratings come only from completed, verified bookings.

find.title: Find your person
find.body: Search by what you need, when and where — or just ask in your own words. Every profile shows real prices and verified reviews.

choose.title: Choose a real time
choose.body: The times you see are free on their calendar right now. Pick one, add any options, and confirm.

kept.title: Consider it kept
kept.body: You get a confirmation, reminders before the day, and one place to reschedule, message or rebook.

pros.title: Your craft deserves a better front desk.
pros.body: Online booking, a calendar that can’t double-book, reminders that cut no-shows, and a page that shows your work the way it deserves. Free while we launch.

any.title: Any service
any.body: Options change price and time automatically.

noDouble.title: Never double-booked
noDouble.body: Every time is checked at the moment of booking.
